== Strategy ==

This is actually a really great deck!

Since many decks are built around the assumption  that your opponent will have cards you can battle or target, it throws many players off-guard when you come up with this.

The main idea is to use Anger, Fear, Aggression every turn while using defensive shields and It  Could Be Worse to absorb damage.  You don't need to use much force, so you always have enough for ICBW.

Between Podracing, AFA, and Surprise Assualt, your opponent ends up taking alot of damage.  Shocking Information and Visored Vision also help to add to that.

Since your opponent is unable to initiate battles, Scum and First Strike become of no use.  Instead, your opponent is forced to have to force drain you to death, which is easily deterred using ICBW, Suprise Assualt, and Projection of a Skywalker.  Honor of the Jedi can also keep you from taking too much damage.

A few problems might arise when your opponent plays cards such as Resistance, Projective Telepathy, or You Cannot Hide Forever (DF).  In this case, you'll need to rely fully on Suprise Assualts to get your damage through. But that's about the only problem I find in this deck.

A few suggestions as to what other cards might be useful in this theme would be helpful.
